validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: real, actively maintained physical asset, not a GEM-only entity. Multiple independent, dated, named sources confirm this exact '2nd line' (2-я нитка) of the Taas-Tumus-Yakutsk trunk gas pipeline: (1) the Sakhatransneftegaz JSC internal commissioning-year table image (ipng.ysn.ru, visually read) lists 'МГ Таас-Тумус-Якутск, 2 нитка | 201,90 км | 1978 | 42 года' — an exact match to the sheet's LengthKnown=201.90/StartYear1=1978; (2) energybase.ru's public procurement listing (dated 28 Nov 2019, closed 16 Dec 2019, customer АО «САХАТРАНСНЕФТЕГАЗ», ИНН 1435142972) for 'Магистральный газопровод Таас-Тумус-Якутск. 2 нитка. Участок 173км -191 км', location 'Дальневосточный федеральный округ, Саха /Якутия/ Респ' — hard procurement-register evidence, not press description; (3) Sakhatransneftegaz's own press service, in TWO separate 2019-2020 articles (aostng.ru's own site, 11 Aug 2020; and via sakhaparliament.ru, 24 May 2020), describing active construction (an 18km new-laid section, autumn 2019-spring 2020) and capital repair (nearly 20km of 530mm pipe replaced across many km-markers) specifically on 'II нитка/2-й нитка МГ «Таас Тумус-Якутск»'. CLASSIFICATION: Fuel=Gas and PipelineType=transmission are correct — every source above calls it a 'магистральный газопровод' (trunk/transmission gas pipeline) carrying natural gas. DUPLICATE CHECK against the 32-row roster and specifically sibling P2334 (1st string, 200.00 km, 1967): the ipng.ysn.ru table lists the two strings as separate rows with different lengths and different commissioning years (1967 vs 1978), and the energybase.ru/aostng.ru/sakhaparliament.ru material independently documents the 2nd string as a later, distinct construction/repair program — confirmed as two parallel physical lines on the same corridor, not a mislabeled duplicate or the same asset double-counted. A length/km-marker note: Sakhatransneftegaz's Aug-2020 press release lists repair-section markers as high as '272-293' km, which on its face exceeds the recorded 201.90 km segment length; however the Nov-2019 energybase.ru tender ties this SAME 2nd line explicitly to km markers 173-191 (well within 201.90 km), and the press release itself mentions a 'threefold increase in pipeline length' for the wider corridor in the same breath — read together, the higher markers most plausibly refer to a broader multi-year repair program along the interconnected Sakhatransneftegaz network (of which sections abut the much-longer Kysyl-Syr-Mastakh-Berge-Yakutsk corridor) rather than contradicting this segment's own recorded length. Not elevated to a formal spec concern given the clean, exact match from the primary commissioning table, but noted here for the record.
